environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with PostgreSQL RDS. The database user 'app_service' is configured with full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'users' table. No additional network segmentation between the application pod and the RDS instance beyond standard VPC security group allowing port 5432.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON TABLE users TO app_service
config.network: VPC security group allows 5432 from app subnet
